security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU emulates the seed CSR (0x015) read without clearing entropy[15:0] and transitioning OPST to WAIT after a successful ES16 poll, or returns non-zero entropy when OPST != ES16, violating wipe-on-read and zero-on-non-ES16 normative rules
security_spec.summary: Missing wipe-on-read side-effect on seed CSR access leaks cryptographic entropy to guest, allowing reuse of one-time random material and breaking guest kernel RNG security assumptions
